name: Hirooka
source: One of the characters of the Correctness storyline. He is a coroner working at the Forensic Medical Center. [spoiler]Plain and forgettable at first glance, he is later revealed to be quite the cynic - having overcome his fear of death innate to working as a coroner, he became an avid collector and watcher of snuff movies. According to him, his collection is both large in terms of size and rare in terms of material.[/spoiler]
